name: Ahikam
bio:
Ahikam son of Shaphan was one of five officials King Josiah sent, along with Hilkiah, Achbor, Shaphan his own father, and Asahiah, to consult Huldah the prophetess about the newly found book of the law and its warnings against Judah (2 Kings 22:12-14).

## 📖 Core Story: Father of Gedaliah

Years later, after Jerusalem's fall, Ahikam's son Gedaliah was appointed governor over the remaining people of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar (2 Kings 25:22). Years earlier, his protection had kept Jeremiah from being executed by an angry mob after the prophet warned the temple would be destroyed (Jeremiah 26:24).
